criteria.formula: certified capacity (pints/day) x 0.473 L per pint / certified IEF (L/kWh) x 1,095 / 24 (DOE's annual dehumidification hours, 10 CFR 430 subpart B appendix X1) x EIA U.S. average residential price x 5
criteria.label: 5-year electricity cost

criteria.formula: 100 pints x 0.473 L per pint / certified IEF (L/kWh) x EIA U.S. average residential price (no operating hours: it depends only on IEF and the rate)
criteria.label: Electricity cost per 100 pints removed

method: We compared the ENERGY STAR whole-home (ducted) dehumidifiers with the highest certified capacity, scoring capacity and IEF. The five-year electricity cost is shown for each (yearly energy computed from certified capacity and IEF at DOE's 1,095 dehumidifying hours a year x current EIA U.S. average residential price x 5; we do not use the listed yearly figure because for some listings it does not match their own capacity and IEF).
name: Best whole-house dehumidifiers, ranked by certified data
scoring: each value scored against the best on the page (best = 1), times its weight; total out of 100

selection.label: Certified capacity
selection.merge: listings with identical certified values on all 11 reported fields

ties.rule: equal scores share a rank; within it products are listed alphabetically (no difference on any column shown; the certified yearly energy differs, see the cards)
